create_TRECEval: create a TRECEval instance to load TREC question-type classification data from a task path
run_TRECEval: run the TRECEval classifier to compute train and test embeddings and evaluate question-type classification accuracy
loadFile_TRECEval: load a TREC label file and parse colon-separated target labels and sample text into structured data
do_prepare_TRECEval: do_prepare TRECEval to collect train and test samples for embedding preparation
test_TRECEval: test the TRECEval module for TREC question-type classification with 6 label categories
